name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Balloon warnings shut Vilnius and Kaunas airports on 10 Nov; France sought EU sanctions over IRGC-linked store attacks
state: Lithuania closed Vilnius and Kaunas airports from about 21:30 on 10 Nov after warnings of balloons from Belarus, as drones crossed the Baltic states overnight (AeroTime). On 10 Nov France summoned Iran's ambassador and sought EU sanctions after attributing the 11–12 Oct attacks on refrigeration in about 700 stores, which caused at least 15 fires, to an IRGC cyber unit (Axios). No casualties were reported and shutdowns were confined to one country, so the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Air travellers to Lithuania may face short-notice closures; check with airlines and FCDO travel advice. Organisations running building or refrigeration controls can follow NCSC guidance on operational technology security.
rubric_hit: Airspace incursions closed airports (Lithuania, 10 Nov) and sabotage attributed to Iran = Watch; no casualties or multi-country shutdowns

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
